name: Vladimir Gavrilovich Shukin
original_name: ウラジミール・ガヴリーロヴィッチ・シューキン
source:
Tonya's brother [spoiler](they are not blood-related)[/spoiler]. A Russian Jinyou, he has journeyed all around the world. Albeit he's Russian, he speaks with an odd American accent due to his admiration of American culture. He's also an otaku; his hobbies are Games, Manga, Anime, Internet surfing. Albeit Tonya vehemently denies it, recently he started "brainwashing" her with these hobbies.

His power is to manipulate soil, earth, and consequently also asphalt and other matters.
